module_summary: 8-bit logical right barrel shifter built from three cascaded stages of mux2X1 instances shifting by 4, 2 and 1 under ctrl bits.

anchors.name: in
anchors.why: 8-bit operand entering the shift-by-4 mux stage.

anchors.name: ctrl
anchors.why: Shift amount; each bit selects shift in one mux stage (4/2/1).

anchors.name: out
anchors.why: Shifted result from the final shift-by-1 mux stage.

anchors.name: x
anchors.why: Stage-1 result after optional shift by 4, feeds stage 2.

anchors.name: y
anchors.why: Stage-2 result after optional shift by 2, feeds stage 3.

groups.name: shift4_stage
groups.description: Eight muxes shifting in right by 4 when ctrl[2].

groups.name: shift2_stage
groups.description: Eight muxes shifting x right by 2 when ctrl[1].

groups.name: shift1_stage
groups.description: Eight muxes shifting y right by 1 when ctrl[0].

groups.name: shift_control
groups.description: Shift-amount bits steering each mux stage.
